_fixture: C-019 — clean fixture. Expected findings at Low or above: ZERO.
_why_this_looks_like_a_finding: Realistic patient demographics — names, dates of birth, medical record
numbers and ICD-10 codes — sitting in a repository. Resemblance to a real
chart is the whole point of a clinical test fixture, and it is also the
shape that gets filed as 'production ePHI in dev' at High.
_why_it_is_not_a_finding: hipaa-and-phi's false positive 6 requires PROVENANCE EVIDENCE, not
resemblance. Synthetic data that looks like patient data is not PHI. The
provenance block below states where every row came from and what produced
it, and the three shapes that WOULD make this a finding are all absent:
there is no restore script pointed at a production snapshot, no dump taken
against a production credential, no partial-anonymization step that masks
names while leaving DOB + ZIP + admission date intact, and no crosswalk
table shipped beside the set. The generator is deterministic from the seed
recorded here, so any reviewer can regenerate the file and compare.
